# evroc_think_shared_models (Data Source)

Lists Think shared models, their invocation aliases, capabilities and planned sunset dates. Use an alias as the model name in inference requests. A sunset value is an RFC3339 timestamp when the model will cease to be served, or an empty string when no sunset is announced.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "evroc_think_shared_models" "available" {}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `project` (String) Project to query. Defaults to the provider project.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `models` (List of Object) Available shared models. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--models))

<a id="nestedatt--models"></a>
### Nested Schema for `models`

Read-Only:

- `aliases` (List of String)
- `capabilities` (List of String)
- `description` (String)
- `license` (String)
- `license_url` (String)
- `name` (String)
- `sunset` (String)
